issue_request: FHIR-11459 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked that the Conformance resource be renamed to CapabilityStatement and recorded the resolution as duplicate of FHIR-9645.
initial_application: The seed issue does not appear in source history by key, but its comments point to FHIR-9645 and say the approved change had been done. FHIR-9645 records the substantive rename decision, and commit 6106a1be5b1703ee84bdbe31a1b6202faa8a567c applied it by changing source/fhir.ini from conformance=Conformance to capabilitystatement=CapabilityStatement and moving source/conformance inputs to source/capabilitystatement.
additional_context: Current build-scope source still registers CapabilityStatement as the active resource and maps it to the conformance area. The current StructureDefinition identity is CapabilityStatement. Source searches found no active current Conformance resource definition; remaining uses of conformance are generic framework terminology, conformance-expectation terminology, examples with historical ids, or legacy support rather than the resource name. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already reflects the approved duplicate-target rename.
